_comment: 012, rebuilt in 088 (A15) around the signature verbs: a real threat, a CANCELLED intent, a pit fall, heat as a choice, a tear. `until` is what ends a step: next (the NEXT button), selected, moved, armed (`weapon`: that arm), attacked, ability, heat_choice (the ability, an attack or a vent), cancelled (an enemy intent lost to the crew, 087's INTENT_LOST), fell (an enemy shoved into a pit), torn (an arm torn off), prop, round (round `round` reached), won; `unit` names the machine it waits on. `point` is one mark or a LIST of marks, shown one at a time (the first not yet done): {unit} (the machine, until it is picked), {cell: [x, y], unit} (a hex to walk to: never one an intent aims at), {weapon: i} / {ability: i} (that button), {enemy: ref}, {pile}, {button: end_turn}, {beside_enemy}, {prop: barrel}. Text only: NOT in the content hash.

steps.title: THE SHAKEDOWN
steps.text: Knuckles, Needle and Relay against three scrap runners. Each turn every machine can MOVE once and ATTACK once. Move first: a machine that attacks is rooted where it stands (only a LINE machine, like Needle, can still move after firing). Then you END TURN and the enemies act. They always show what they will do first.

steps.title: READ THE ENEMY
steps.text: The red hexes and numbered badges are INTENTS: where each enemy fires when you end your turn, in that order. The Yard Gunner and the Runner Boss both aim their lances through Relay: 6 damage, all of Relay's HP. That is a real threat. Nothing fires until you end the turn, so step out of the red, or break the shooter first.

steps.title: BREAK IT FIRST
steps.text: Needle can reach the Yard Gunner. Click Needle (or press 2), then its RAIL LANCE in the WEAPONS row. Its targets light up yellow.

steps.title: CANCEL ITS SHOT
steps.text: Click the Yard Gunner to aim: the panel on the right says exactly what will happen. Click it again to fire. A wreck fires nothing: its intent is CANCELLED, and Relay is out of half the red.

steps.title: MOVE
steps.text: Knuckles next. Click Knuckles (or press 1), then the hex with the amber ring, beside the Yard Runner. The blue hexes are where it can walk; a ring never sits in the red.

steps.title: INTO THE PIT
steps.text: The BREAKER HAMMER shoves what it hits one hex away from Knuckles, and right behind the Yard Runner is a pit. Arm the hammer and hit the runner, twice to fire. Whatever falls in a pit is gone, at any HP.

steps.title: HEAT IS A CHOICE
steps.text: A hit of 5 or more TEARS an arm off. Relay's Scattergun alone falls short on the Runner Boss; FOCUS adds +2 to its next hit, for 1 HEAT. Every attack makes heat (the number on the card), and at the cap (Relay's is 6) a machine SEIZES: it skips its next attack. VENT (V) dumps heat instead of attacking. Here the heat buys a tear: click Relay (or press 3), then FOCUS.

steps.title: TEAR AN ARM OFF
steps.text: Walk Relay to the amber ring, arm the SCATTERGUN and fire at the Runner Boss. Arms tear right arm first: its lance, the one aimed at Relay. A torn arm's intent is cancelled too.

steps.title: END TURN
steps.text: Every machine has acted. END TURN (Space): the enemies do exactly what their intents showed, and what was cancelled does nothing. Then they show the next round's.

steps.title: SCRAP PILES
steps.text: An enemy with the scrap mark on its tag carries scrap: break it and it leaves a pile. Ending a move on a pile gives scrap and 2 HP. Enemies grab them too, to patch themselves: watch the Runner Boss.

steps.title: FINISH IT
steps.text: Every fight has an OBJECTIVE, top left. This one is ROUT: break every enemy. The Runner Boss has one arm and a few HP left. Tap anything on the board, or any blue word, to see what it is.

steps.title: THAT IS THE LOOP
steps.text: A run is this, site after site: fight, take salvage, build your machines in the garage, and reach the gate before the Reclaimer catches the key.

ladder.title: THE LADDER
ladder.text: Unlocks come between runs: a crew or part opens the moment its goal is met. Win a run to open the next RUNG: one more announced rule, on top of every rung below. NEW RUN starts on the highest open rung; CHANGE steps down.

new_part.title: NEW PARTS
new_part.text: An unlocked part is not handed to you: from your next run it can turn up in salvage, at traders and at auctions. Its card says what it does when you meet it.

exposed.title: EXPOSED!
exposed.text: The boss is caught open: this turn it has no armour or shields and takes double from every hit. Throw everything at it now.

seized.title: SEIZED
seized.text: This machine hit its heat cap: this round it can still move, but not attack. Watch the heat on its card, and VENT before it reaches the cap.

map.title: THE MAP
map.text: Click a lit site to travel there: your crew walks the road. Every 2 moves the Reclaimer takes a zone (its gauge is at the top; its red ghost shows the line it takes next). Sites in the fog are not scouted yet.

bay.title: BUILD YOUR CREW
bay.text: Step each socket through the bench with < and >. Two parts from one maker on a machine make a set: the green lines under its name. ROLL OUT when the crew is ready.

salvage.title: SALVAGE
salvage.text: Take one part into the hold, or the scrap instead. The green lines on a card say what it would beat and which maker set it would make.

garage.title: THE GARAGE
garage.text: Drag a part from the hold onto a socket (or tap it, then tap the socket). Hover a part to see it on the machine. LEVEL UP spends scrap: +2 HP and a perk of your choice.

perks.title: PERKS
perks.text: A level adds its HP and ONE of these, kept for the rest of the run. Each card says exactly what it adds. A card with a rust band (+ MARKS) is a new rule: it changes what the machine does, not just its numbers.

affix.title: ELITE AFFIX
affix.text: This elite's veteran carries a rule of its own, named under its site and over it in the fight. Plan for it before you walk in: tap the machine in the fight to read it again.

spoils.title: TORN FROM
spoils.text: The card under TORN FROM is a part your crew ripped off an enemy in this fight. Tear an arm off the machine you want it from, and it can turn up here.

workshop.title: WORKSHOP
workshop.text: Patch the crew, rebuild a wreck, buy room in the hold, or UPGRADE a part: one of two upgrades, once per part.

tune.title: UPGRADES
tune.text: Pick a part on the left, then one of its two upgrades on the right. An upgraded part is marked + and cannot be upgraded again.

fight.title: YOUR TURN
fight.text: Blue hexes: where the picked machine can move. Red: where the enemies will fire when you END TURN. Tap anything on the board to see what it is; blue words are links.

_comment_hints: First-time hints: one per screen, shown the first time it opens, remembered in the profile once dismissed (Hints.show_once).
